title: Positive circuit size
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every Boolean circuit $c$ on $n$ variables, its size is at least $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables
replaced:
Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables. Then the size of $C$ — the total number
of literal leaves and internal AND/OR gates — is at least $1$; that is, $1 \le
\mathrm{size}(C)$.
